description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyDeleted class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package. It verifies object immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and deserialization, as well as exception handling during object creation.

classes.name: PolicyDeletedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PolicyDeleted, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the PolicyDeleted class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a PolicyDeleted instance with a null PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Tests that creating a PolicyDeleted instance with a null PolicyId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null headers when creating a PolicyDeleted instance throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns the expected JsonObject matching the known JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Checks that a PolicyDeleted instance can be correctly created from valid JSON.
